outcome: Obtain a compact latent representation that preserves object geometry.

Record memory, throughput, latent shapes, and a checkpoint with checksum.
Freeze and share the selected autoencoder across diffusion comparisons.

title: Train the conditional VAE baseline E0
outcome: Establish a lower-cost generative baseline with the agreed action inputs.
acceptance: Condition on the first frame, selected-object mask, and numeric force.
Define the posterior, prior, reconstruction loss, and KL weight; sample from the prior without future frames at inference.
Pass a tiny-batch overfit check and produce four seeded samples per condition.
Log validation results, model size, training cost, and checkpoint selection.
Add a run manifest and qualitative successes/failures.

title: Implement first-frame and numeric-action diffusion E1/E2
outcome: Create the common diffusion backbone and the main numeric-action baseline.
acceptance: Implement latent video training and sampling with a shared backbone/configuration.
Support first-frame-only E1 and selected-mask-plus-numeric-force E2.
Pass forward/backward, tiny-batch overfit, and checkpoint resume checks.
Measure 64px peak VRAM, seconds/step, and four-sample inference latency.
Record baseline samples and proposed run budgets.
progress: The untrained prototype supports first-frame and numeric conditioning with forward/backward checks. Dataset training, the diffusion schedule/sampler, overfitting, and trained samples remain outstanding.

title: Implement object-centric spatial conditioning E3
outcome: Test whether localizing the action improves physical action adherence.
acceptance: Fuse a selected-object feature, numeric force embedding, and spatial action map into the denoiser.
Keep target identification available in E2 so E2-to-E3 isolates the spatial module.
Check selected-object changes, zero/reversed action, and empty or invalid masks with fixed sampling seeds.
Record added parameter count, ablation switch, and working E3 training/sampling.
progress: Numeric/spatial conditioning switches exist in the prototype with equal parameter counts. Working E3 training/sampling and learned action-control checks remain outstanding.

title: Add trajectory and collision supervision E4
outcome: Test whether physical supervision improves decoded future behavior.
acceptance: Predict trajectories and object-pair collision probabilities from denoiser features.
Define timestep supervision, object-slot matching, valid masks, imbalance handling, and loss weights.
Keep oracle trajectories/collisions/physics out of inference conditioning; any extra object extraction must use first-frame pixels only.
Validate loss gradients and tiny-batch behavior; demonstrate E4 training and sampling.
Report head predictions separately from generated-video tracking metrics.
owner: BOBAN ATHUL KRISHNA and KAPOOR ANANYA
progress: Implemented frame-0 canonical object matching, padded trajectory/collision targets, Smooth L1 and unordered-pair BCE, training-set class-balance estimation, low-timestep gating, and head-to-scene mapping. Real-head gradient and synthetic prediction-fitting checks pass. Dataset E4 training/sampling and measured head-versus-video results remain pending. See [loss integration](AUXILIARY_LOSSES.md).
evidence: docs/AUXILIARY_LOSSES.md; docs/results/auxiliary-loss-checks.json; tests/test_auxiliary_losses.py. No trained E4 generator or sampler yet.
